rows.en: Ymir: "Are you all right? You don't look very well..."
Touya: "I feel kind of dizzy, but I'm okay."
Ymir: "As I thought, going straight into a real battle took its toll..."
Ymir: "Yamato is in surgery right now.
The explosion during the battle startled her,
and she jumped out of the bag...
We managed to avoid being trapped under the rubble,
She tried desperately to get Yamato out.
Ymir: "Yes. She said she'd save her herself, and the rubble..."
Touya: "I see... Until her hands got like that..."
on Yamato now. I'm sure he can..."
Gabon: "...Calm down. For now, she's out of immediate danger."
Gabon: "But her internal organs are badly damaged,
and she won't last long as she is.
The way to save her is to replace them with artificial organs.
What's more, to keep her body's balance, 80% of it
will need replacing with artificial substitutes.
I've never performed an operation this extensive on an animal before,
but don't worry. I'll find a way."
Touya: "I don't care what it takes! Just save Yamato!"
Gabon: "All right! Leave it to me!"
Gabon: "Don't worry. I'll save her. I promise."
?????: "Yes. Resonance with that has been confirmed.
We've never seen a reaction this strong before."
???: "Hey, there's no need to use such a roundabout
Without someone who can operate that,
Unfortunately, even with my technology, it's impossible
to create such a person. That leaves us no choice but to find a compatible candidate."
???: "Well, this invasion is part of that too,
but are you sure it'll be all right?"
as long as we obtain the crystal she has. The problem is that
he, the compatible candidate, is in York too.
I hope it doesn't become troublesome."
????: "The Spirit Mech...? I don't expect it to be a problem,
but you're handling that, so it'll be all right, won't it?"
?????: "I'll do my best to meet your expectations.
I wouldn't want to disappoint you."
????: "Heh heh heh. Well, I'll be going.
I'm counting on you for the rest."
?????: "...The age gap between her and me is that of a parent and child.
If anything, you would be a more natural match."
Still devoted even after being betrayed... Is that it?"
I'm leaving Zigrim to you. It took considerable effort
???: "You don't have to tell me... Is what I'd like to say,
but they started moving sooner than I'd expected.
On the suggestion of that president, Horem, or whatever his name is."
?????: "Which was only possible thanks to the technology we provided.
???: "Well, yeah. More importantly, be careful that this compatible candidate
doesn't get caught up in it and die."
Clovis: "Hm? Where have Ymir and Ai gone?"
Clovis: "Come on. Is this the man who piloted Zeifon
in his first battle? Cheer up."
????: "Here, have a drink and try to relax.
It's something like what we call coffee in our world.
It's quite bitter, but rather good once you get used to it."
Clovis: "...Sigh. I suppose we can only leave him alone for now..."
I was brought to this world. Good to meet you."
Clovis: "And this stuck-up fellow here is
Arthur: "Could you give me a better introduction than that?"
I'm from Zimbabwe. The place I lived, though not my birthplace,
Clovis: "He won't know it as Salisbury.
Arthur: "It seems people from Japan don't know it."
Well, never mind that. Don't be so down."
Clovis: "...I don't know who this Yamato is,
but they've got someone who cares this much. I'm sure they'll pull through.
If you don't believe, those feelings won't get through, will they?"
Have some of this... if you'd like.
??????: "...Um, you shouldn't push yourself too hard...
I'll do a little charm to cheer you up."
??????: "Here, I'll hold your hand like this..."
??????: "It'll be all right. It'll be all right...
It'll be all right. It'll be all right........"
??????: "It'll be all right. It'll be all right...
It seems my family has a special power..."
Touya: "...Is it not a very good power to have?
Lately, I often see an image
of a black shadow chasing me."
This gloomy talk must be boring you."
Touya: "Want me to hold your hand this time?"
??????: "Hee hee hee... You're all right now."
Touya: "Yeah. I can't just keep moping.
Someone told me earlier that those feelings won't get through
It's hard to convey your feelings... That's why you have to believe strongly,
It's... a gift from someone very dear to me."
Gabon: "I told you not to worry, didn't I?"
Gabon: "Yes. She's saved. She's asleep now,
but she should be up and about tomorrow."
Gabon: "He's all right. The exhaustion must have caught up with him.
Barkin: "This is what happens when you swallow information whole
from some shady kid dressed all in black."
Resh: "No, the information was correct. There really
was a Spirit Mech there. We simply miscalculated
Barkin: "I won't let it end like this. Next time..."
Resh: "Say, Barkin. I've got a good idea."
Barkin: "Huh? But we've barely got any usable Armored Mechs.
And we were told it'd take at least another three days for that guy to arrive..."
I've got a good plan to give them a nasty surprise. Heh heh heh heh..."
Resh: "Battles aren't fought with muscle alone.
Barkin: "Hm? I've got a pretty hard head too, you know."
